title: 事实表粒度（grain）校验器：重复粒度键检测
code:
# 事实表粒度（grain）校验器：声明粒度是否被违背
# 声明粒度：一张 dwd_order_detail 表 = 一个订单的一个商品明细行
DECLARED_GRAIN = ("order_id", "sku_id")

# 用例 A：合规明细（每个 (order_id, sku_id) 唯一）
ROWS_A = [
    ("SO001", "SKU1", 2, 100),
    ("SO001", "SKU2", 1, 50),
    ("SO002", "SKU1", 3, 150),
    ("SO002", "SKU3", 1, 80),
    ("SO003", "SKU2", 5, 250),
]

# 用例 B：违规明细（SO002/SKU1 出现两次 —— 上游 join 扇出导致）
ROWS_B = [
    ("SO001", "SKU1", 2, 100),
    ("SO001", "SKU2", 1, 50),
    ("SO002", "SKU1", 3, 150),
    ("SO002", "SKU1", 3, 150),
    ("SO003", "SKU2", 5, 250),
]


def grain_key(row, grain):
    idx = {"order_id": 0, "sku_id": 1}
    return tuple(row[idx[c]] for c in grain)


def check_grain(rows, grain):
    seen = {}
    for r in rows:
        k = grain_key(r, grain)
        seen[k] = seen.get(k, 0) + 1
    dup = sorted((k, c) for k, c in seen.items() if c > 1)
    return dup, len(seen)


def report(tag, rows, expect_clean):
    dup, distinct = check_grain(rows, DECLARED_GRAIN)
    print("== 用例 " + tag + "：" + ("合规明细（期望 0 个重复粒度键）" if expect_clean
                                  else "含重复粒度键（期望 >0）") + " ==")
    print("  声明粒度 = " + "+".join(DECLARED_GRAIN))
    print("  明细行数 = " + str(len(rows)))
    print("  去重粒度键数 = " + str(distinct))
    print("  重复粒度键 = " + (str(dup) if dup else "无"))
    clean = (len(dup) == 0 and len(rows) == distinct)
    print("  粒度合规性 = " + str(clean))
    print("  期望方向 = " + ("合规" if expect_clean else "违规"))
    print("  是否符合预期 = " + str(clean == expect_clean))
    return clean


ok_a = report("A", ROWS_A, True)
print("")
ok_b = report("B", ROWS_B, False)

print("")
print("== 附加：JOIN 扇出导致的粒度膨胀（声明粒度被破坏的常见原因） ==")
orders_a = [("SO001",), ("SO002",), ("SO003",)]
# 优惠券维表：同一订单对应 2 张券 -> join 后行数翻倍
coupon = [("SO001", "C1"), ("SO001", "C2"), ("SO002", "C3"), ("SO002", "C4"), ("SO003", "C5")]
joined = [(o[0], c[1]) for o in orders_a for c in coupon if c[0] == o[0]]
before = len(orders_a)
after = len(joined)
fanout_ok = (after > before)
print("  JOIN 前行数 = " + str(before) + "，JOIN 后行数 = " + str(after))
print("  行数膨胀倍数 = " + str(round(after / before, 2)))
print("  判据（join 键不唯一造成扇出，行数增加）: " + str(fanout_ok))

print("")
print("判据 1（合规明细通过粒度校验）: " + str(ok_a))
print("判据 2（含重复粒度键的明细被检出）: " + str(not ok_b))
print("判据 3（join 前需先聚合维表至唯一键，否则扇出）: " + str(fanout_ok))

== 用例 A：合规明细（期望 0 个重复粒度键） ==
  声明粒度 = order_id+sku_id
  明细行数 = 5
  去重粒度键数 = 5
  重复粒度键 = 无
  粒度合规性 = True
  期望方向 = 合规
  是否符合预期 = True

== 用例 B：含重复粒度键（期望 >0） ==
  声明粒度 = order_id+sku_id
  明细行数 = 5
  去重粒度键数 = 4
  重复粒度键 = [(('SO002', 'SKU1'), 2)]
  粒度合规性 = False
  期望方向 = 违规
  是否符合预期 = True

  JOIN 前行数 = 3，JOIN 后行数 = 5
  行数膨胀倍数 = 1.67
